BE-delete-endpoint-contract-check only verifies an endpoint that no task creates, and BE-status-change-completion-date-logic 'extends the status change endpoint from US-create-task', which US-create-task does not build.","suggested_fix":"Add tasks in US-create-task (or the owning stories) that create the update, delete and status change endpoints, or rewrite BE-delete-endpoint-contract-check to create DELETE /tasks/{id}."},{"check_id":"CRIT-MISSING","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-create-task","requirement_ids":["R-1c2262bc"],"message":"Creation Date is a task field and the create endpoint sets it. The PRD describes a personal task list and mentions no authentication or user ownership, and no user_id field exists in the data model.","suggested_fix":"Remove signed-in/ownership wording from the story, ACs AC1, AC8, edge cases and from BE-get-tasks-read-all-endpoint; return all tasks."},{"check_id":"CRIT-UNREQUESTED","severity":"warning","item_key":"BE-report-metrics-endpoint","requirement_ids":[],"message":"The task says metrics are for the 'signed-in user', but the PRD has no authentication concept. FE-delete-result-banner also removes the task from the list on success, which duplicates the refresh and conflicts with 'rows reflect the saved change' via re-fetch.","suggested_fix":"Narrow FE-delete-result-banner to messages only and rely on FE-task-list-auto-refresh for updating the list."},{"check_id":"CRIT-CONSTRAINT","severity":"warning","item_key":"US-create-task","requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7"],"message":"The success and error messages are required after create actions, but AC4 and AC5 are the only ACs on the error path; there is no AC for the list refreshing after creation even though auto-refresh applies (R-6a73fa71), and AC5 ('only Low, Medium and High can be selected') has no clear failing case.","suggested_fix":"Add an AC that the new task appears in the list after a confirmed create, and rephrase AC5 as selecting from exactly three options."}]}
